_note: One place for everything likely to change about reviewers: which models are tried per role, what a tag may name, what one review costs, quota kept back, and dated notes. How it is read, and how to change it, is docs/workflow.md -> Choosing a reviewer. Defaults are tried in order, first to last: the first that has a local CLI, enough usage, no reservation against it, and a working bubblewrap sandbox wins. Models here are the cheap end of what is allowed; the expensive ones are kept for sensitive work. Why each is here: docs/workflow.md and docs/research/reviewer-models-2026-11.md.
_note_zai: zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3 is the same GLM on the Z.ai coding-plan connector, which does not touch OpenCode Go quota. It needs that connector signed in on the runner (tools/runner-setup.md) and is not a default.

notes.note: Pools differ inside one provider: Opus and Sonnet share Claude's weekly pool, Fable 5.2 has its own. Recheck when Claude's plans change.
On OpenCode Go, GLM-5.3 empties that allowance several times faster per review than DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, so DeepSeek is the default and GLM goes through the Z.ai coding plan.
Cursor bills API list price on top of its subscription, so one Cursor review costs more than one review anywhere else.
